visemesNote: Rhubarb mouth shapes (A-H, X rest) mapped onto the existing baked-envelope shape keys; peaks stay inside the original take's ranges.
clipsNote: category drives automatic placement; onset/stroke/apex/release = frames from clip start to first movement, peak hand speed, furthest hand reach and last movement. Count clips centre their active span on the list words; all others put their apex on the cue word.

mixamo.note: Retargeted onto Host.rig at build time by scripts/cast_mixamo_retarget.py. gain damps a Mixamo bone (no side): shoulders so MakeHuman shoulder weights do not bulge, spine/neck/head because the hips stay planted (full Mixamo torso lean reads as falling) and to keep gaze near the camera. categories: keyword -> category, first match wins (scripts/cast-mixamo-landmarks.py). Gesture windows longer than maxFrames are cut to maxFrames around their apex. Clips whose wrists move faster than maxHandSpeed (m/s; the original take peaks at 1.6) get tempo < 1 and play slower. Clips reaching further than maxAutoReachCm are left out of automatic planning. hold pulls bones toward the presenter idle pose (head toward camera; the unused arm of one-handed clips). smooth is a Gaussian sigma (frames) against mocap jitter.

groupRules.note: Used by scripts/cast-motion-groups.py. Words match the clip name or source performance.

phonemeVisemes.note: ARPAbet (MFA english_us_arpa) to blends of the existing mouth keys. Used by scripts/cast_lip_phonemes.py. A_lowerDown is not used: it drops the lip without the oral meshes, exposing gums. maxValue caps the jaw where teeth still meet the lips.
